_note: EDIT ME. Landmarks and arms follow Tabel 3 (goniometer alignment), sagittal view of the tested side. Target angles come from ChenData/StrengthCurve/plot_proposal.m. An angle is the angle between two 'arms'. An arm is [dotA, dotB] (vector from A to B), {"perp": [dotA, dotB]} (perpendicular to A-B, pointing towards the feet), or "up" / "down" / "forward". Shown value = sign * angle + offset. 'signed' angles can be negative (extension, posterior tilt); their sign assumes the participant faces RIGHT, and the app mirrors automatically when you choose 'faces left'.

dot_labels.strap: strap marker (on the person, where the strap attaches)
dot_labels.anchor: anchor marker (fixed end of the strap, rope or chain)

_optional_dots_note: Extra dots that are tracked and recorded but not part of any angle. They start switched off; tick them in Landmarks to use them. Per test you can override with "optional_dots".

tests._note_tests: Sagittal tests from Tabel 2 of the protocol draft 2026-09-28 (19 positions in all, 4 of them hip abduction/adduction in the frontal plane, which this app does not do). 'targets' are the positions of the measured joint. 'neighbour_targets' are the required angles of the neighbouring joint (H 90, K 0, K 90 in Tabel 2); they are judged from the start, not only after Lock. Extension and plantarflexion are negative in the protocol's table, here they are positions of the joint (hip flexion angle, ankle angle with plantarflexion negative).
